prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of a compact ring of six thin matte six-sided hexagon tiles in wood, ceramic and frosted glass, evenly spaced around one larger deep blue six-sided hexagon tile at the centre, the whole ring filling the middle half of the frame. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting on the central blue tile. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
